ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High; approximately 90% high-intensity white surface area with 10% low-intensity black perimeter and focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes; distinct low-intensity black perimeter banding (widest at distal tips); a concentrated cluster of irregular low-intensity pixels at the central peduncle insertion point; sparse, small focal dark spots on the distal right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; amplitude of peaks varies from 3 to 12 pixels; most pronounced saw-tooth pattern located on the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the upper margins of both lobes, tapering sharply toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of 6-10 small, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters localized on the distal-medial region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three short, horizontally-aligned dark linear pixel disruptions located in the medial region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch/indentation on the proximal trailing edge of the left lobe; significant low-intensity terminal mark on the distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Feathered/diffuse dark pigmentation spray radiating outward from the central notch area.
